note: ib_dam_media (submodule of ib_dam) provides the ib_dam_embed media source/type (source field field_media_ib_dam_embed, a link field) and an IntelligenceBank asset browser at /ib-dam-browser added to the core media_library_add_form_upload form. Config object ib_dam_media.settings (keys upload_location, media_types = sequence of {source_type, media_type}) edited at /admin/config/services/ib_dam/media behind 'administer intelligencebank configuration'. NO config ships by default. MediaTypeMatcher service (ib_dam_media.media_type_matcher) resolves IB source type -> local media type; MediaStorage persists assets as media. Cases grounded in ib_dam_media.settings, the media type, and the source field.

evals.prompt: In the ib_dam_media module, what is the machine name of the media type/source it provides, and what is the source field that stores the IntelligenceBank asset link?
evals.expected_output: The media source and media type id is ib_dam_embed, and the source field is field_media_ib_dam_embed (a core link field).

evals.prompt: What does the ib_dam_media configuration form at /admin/config/services/ib_dam/media let you configure, and in which config object is it stored?
evals.expected_output: It maps IntelligenceBank source asset types to local media types (and sets the upload_location for downloaded files). It is stored in the ib_dam_media.settings config object (keys upload_location and media_types, a sequence of {source_type, media_type}).

evals.prompt: How do editors reach the IntelligenceBank asset browser when adding media with ib_dam_media, and what route/path does it use?
evals.expected_output: ib_dam_media adds an 'Open IntelligenceBank Browser' button to the core Media Library upload form; it opens the asset browser in a modal at /ib-dam-browser (route id_dam_media.asset_browser_form). The embed option only shows when ib_dam.settings.allow_embedding is enabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, where does ib_dam_media save downloaded IntelligenceBank files? Inspect the live configuration and give the upload location.
On this Drupal site, ib_dam_media has a media-type mapping configured. Inspect the live configuration and state which local Drupal media type the IntelligenceBank 'document' source type is mapped to.
evals.expected_output: In ib_dam_media.settings.media_types the 'document' source_type is mapped to the local media type 'video' on this site.

evals.prompt: Configure ib_dam_media so that downloaded IntelligenceBank files are stored in public://ib-dam-files, and apply the change to the live configuration.
Configure ib_dam_media so that the IntelligenceBank 'image' source type is mapped to the local 'image' media type, and apply the mapping to the live configuration.
evals.expected_output: ib_dam_media.settings.media_types contains an entry {source_type: image, media_type: image}.
